description: OWASP Top 10 CI/CD Security Risks mapped to GitHub settings and configurations

rules.name: Branch protection prevents unauthorized flow control
rules.description: CICD-SEC-1: Insufficient Flow Control. Branch protection rules must be in place to prevent unauthorized changes from flowing directly into production branches without proper review gates.
rules.remediation: Enable branch protection on all production and release branches. Require PR reviews and status checks.

rules.name: Required reviewers enforced for merge flow control
rules.description: CICD-SEC-1: Insufficient Flow Control. Pull request reviews must be required to ensure human oversight in the merge process, preventing a single actor from introducing malicious changes.
rules.remediation: Require at least one approving review before merging. Consider requiring reviews from CODEOWNERS.

rules.name: Stale reviews dismissed on new pushes
rules.description: CICD-SEC-1: Insufficient Flow Control. Stale reviews must be dismissed when new commits are pushed to prevent approved-then-modified attack patterns.
rules.remediation: Enable 'Dismiss stale pull request approvals when new commits are pushed' in branch protection.

rules.name: Organization 2FA requirement enforced
rules.description: CICD-SEC-2: Inadequate Identity and Access Management. Two-factor authentication must be required for all organization members to prevent account takeover attacks.
rules.remediation: Require 2FA for all organization members in Organization Settings > Authentication security.

rules.name: Default repository permission follows least privilege
rules.description: CICD-SEC-2: Inadequate Identity and Access Management. Default repository permissions should be 'none' or 'read' to enforce least privilege access control.
rules.remediation: Set default repository permission to 'No permission' or 'Read' in Organization Settings > Member privileges.

rules.name: Outside collaborator invitations restricted
rules.description: CICD-SEC-2: Inadequate Identity and Access Management. Outside collaborator invitations should be restricted to admins to prevent unauthorized external access to repositories.
rules.remediation: Restrict outside collaborator invitations to organization owners in Member privileges settings.

rules.name: Dependency graph enabled for supply chain visibility
rules.description: CICD-SEC-3: Dependency Chain Abuse. The dependency graph must be enabled to provide visibility into all project dependencies and detect potential supply chain attacks.
rules.remediation: Enable dependency graph for all repositories in Organization Settings > Code security and analysis.

rules.name: Dependabot alerts enabled for vulnerability detection
rules.description: CICD-SEC-3: Dependency Chain Abuse. Dependabot alerts must be enabled to detect known vulnerabilities in dependencies that could be exploited in supply chain attacks.
rules.remediation: Enable Dependabot alerts for all repositories in Organization Settings > Code security and analysis.

rules.name: Dependabot security updates auto-remediate vulnerabilities
rules.description: CICD-SEC-3: Dependency Chain Abuse. Dependabot security updates should be enabled to automatically create PRs that fix vulnerable dependencies.
rules.remediation: Enable Dependabot security updates for all repositories in Organization Settings > Code security and analysis.

rules.name: Fork PR workflow execution requires approval
rules.description: CICD-SEC-4: Poisoned Pipeline Execution. Workflow runs triggered by fork pull requests must require approval to prevent malicious code execution from untrusted contributors.
rules.remediation: Require approval for all fork pull request workflows in Repository Settings > Actions > General.

rules.name: Workflow permissions follow least privilege
rules.description: CICD-SEC-4: Poisoned Pipeline Execution. Default workflow permissions should be read-only to minimize the blast radius if a workflow is compromised.
rules.remediation: Set default workflow permissions to read-only in Repository Settings > Actions > General > Workflow permissions.

rules.name: GITHUB_TOKEN default permissions restricted
rules.description: CICD-SEC-5: Insufficient PBAC (Pipeline-Based Access Controls). The GITHUB_TOKEN should have restricted default permissions to limit what pipelines can do without explicit permission grants.
rules.remediation: Set GITHUB_TOKEN default permissions to read-only. Grant write permissions explicitly in individual workflows.

rules.name: Actions restricted to approved actions only
rules.description: CICD-SEC-5: Insufficient PBAC. GitHub Actions should be restricted to approved actions to prevent execution of untrusted third-party pipeline components.
rules.remediation: Restrict allowed actions to selected actions from verified creators or specific repositories.

rules.name: Secret scanning detects credential exposure
rules.description: CICD-SEC-6: Insufficient Credential Hygiene. Secret scanning must be enabled to detect accidentally committed credentials, tokens, and API keys.
rules.remediation: Enable secret scanning in Repository Settings > Code security and analysis > Secret scanning.

rules.name: Push protection prevents secret commits
rules.description: CICD-SEC-6: Insufficient Credential Hygiene. Push protection must be enabled to block pushes containing secrets before they reach the repository.
rules.remediation: Enable push protection in Repository Settings > Code security and analysis > Push protection.

rules.name: No unresolved secret scanning alerts
rules.description: CICD-SEC-6: Insufficient Credential Hygiene. All secret scanning alerts should be resolved with exposed credentials rotated immediately.
rules.remediation: Rotate all exposed secrets immediately, then resolve alerts in Security tab > Secret scanning alerts.

rules.name: Repository visibility appropriately set
rules.description: CICD-SEC-7: Insecure System Configuration. Repositories containing sensitive code or infrastructure configurations should not be public unless intended.
rules.remediation: Review repository visibility. Change to private or internal if the repository contains sensitive content.

rules.name: Wiki disabled for security-sensitive repositories
rules.description: CICD-SEC-7: Insecure System Configuration. Wikis should be disabled on repositories where they are not needed to reduce the attack surface.
rules.remediation: Disable the wiki in Repository Settings > General > Features > Wikis if not actively used.

rules.name: Third-party actions restricted to verified creators
rules.description: CICD-SEC-8: Ungoverned Usage of 3rd Party Services. Only actions from verified creators or specified repositories should be allowed to prevent supply chain attacks through malicious actions.
rules.remediation: Restrict actions to selected verified creators and pinned action versions in Repository Settings > Actions.

rules.name: GitHub Marketplace app installations reviewed
rules.description: CICD-SEC-8: Ungoverned Usage of 3rd Party Services. Installed GitHub Apps and OAuth Apps should be reviewed and limited to only those that are necessary and trusted.
rules.remediation: Review all installed GitHub Apps in Organization Settings > Third-party access > GitHub Apps. Remove unnecessary apps.

rules.name: Signed commits required for artifact integrity
rules.description: CICD-SEC-9: Improper Artifact Integrity Validation. Signed commits should be required to ensure the integrity and authenticity of code changes.
rules.remediation: Require signed commits in branch protection rules to validate commit authorship.

rules.name: Status checks validate artifact integrity
rules.description: CICD-SEC-9: Improper Artifact Integrity Validation. Required status checks should include artifact validation steps to ensure build outputs have not been tampered with.
rules.remediation: Add artifact validation status checks to branch protection required checks.

rules.name: Audit log accessible and monitored
rules.description: CICD-SEC-10: Insufficient Logging and Visibility. The organization audit log should be actively monitored to detect suspicious activities and security events.
rules.remediation: Ensure the organization audit log is accessible and configure log streaming to a SIEM for continuous monitoring.

rules.name: Webhook configurations use HTTPS and secrets
rules.description: CICD-SEC-10: Insufficient Logging and Visibility. Webhooks should use HTTPS URLs and have a secret configured for payload validation to prevent tampering and eavesdropping.
rules.remediation: Update all webhooks to use HTTPS URLs and configure webhook secrets for payload verification.
